title: Cartorium
description: A Patreon-tier-gated battlemap marketplace browser. Browse the Cartorium Vault catalog and one-click install maps, scenes, and (tier-permitting) premium tokens, actors, and journals directly into your world.

recommends.reason: Required for maps with interactive trigger tiles (e.g. Thieves Guild) to function - not needed to browse or install maps.
Used by some maps' trigger tiles alongside Monk's Active Tile Triggers - not needed to browse or install maps.
